answer: Trust transfers at one timestamped instant: when a voucher's signed attestation is accepted and its bond locks into escrow. That act derives a nullifier from both keys plus the epoch seed, and the ledge of settled state records it. A second vouch for the same pair in that epoch yields the same nullifier, so validators reject it. Across the tundra of open sign-ups, every opal-tinted receipt marks one crossing and nothing more.
